title: Father Abraham Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Father Abraham Bible Crossword
description: Solve an Abraham Bible crossword: the call from Ur, Sarah and Isaac, the stars of the promise, and Mount Moriah. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A man is told to leave his country and his kindred for a land he will be shown, and he goes. Father Abraham follows the whole arc — the promise of a seed as numberless as the stars, the long wait, the laughter in the tent, and the hardest morning of his life on a mountain in the land of Moriah.

The clues cover the people around him as well as the promise: Sarah, Lot, Hagar and Ishmael, Isaac, and the ram caught in a thicket by his horns. The closing verse is the one Paul would later build an argument on.

clues.text: Abraham’s wife, who laughed in the tent door
Land he was sent to, leaving his country
What he did in the LORD, counted to him for righteousness

verseText: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
